title: ORCHID-Bench: synthetic benchmark for extracting thermodynamic data from documents
description: Synthetic benchmark for extracting thermodynamic data from documents: invariant-reaction tables and phase diagrams generated from SGTE assessments with known answers, rendered as born-digital PDFs and degraded scans, with the generator and scorer. Code MIT; benchmark data CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md).
notes: This work was supported by the U.S. National Science Foundation under awards OAC-2608825 and 2534344.
